text:
noelle: Quick thread Update: I'm doing a targeted pass on docs naming and snippets today. Main questions: prefer 'model variant' vs 'variant' in prose, canonical param name (model_id) in backend docs, and JS/Python snippet casing mapping. Also need to sweep migration docs for old embed links. Can we decide quick? cc @emily @rahul

emily: Prefer using 'model variant' in prose (two words) and 'Variant' as UI label. In snippets: show language-idiomatic keys and add a 1-line mapping comment.

rahul: +1. Backend canonical field = `model_id`. For SDKs: Python -> `model_id`, JS -> `modelVariantId`, YAML/configs -> `model_variant_id`. I'll add that table to the style guide appendix.

matt: Found 5 curl snippets using form-encoded `model=`. I'll convert them to JSON bodies with `model_id` and open a PR. Example for the migration guide:

noelle: Old curl snippet:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d 'model=gpt-3&input=hi'

noelle: New suggestion (include in PR):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-3","input":"hi"}'

cli-bot: lint: found inconsistent key casing in examples/chat.md: line 22 uses `model_id` in JS example (suggest `modelVariantId`)

emily: I'll take the JS examples pass and replace `model_id` with `modelVariantId` where it's a JS snippet, adding a comment: `// maps to backend model_id`.

rahul: I'll prepare the style guide PR with the casing table, the 'variant' vs 'replica' note, and the SLO vs SLA guidance (SLO in docs; SLA only in contractual pages).

matt: Quick question: do we keep the term 'replica' anywhere public? I think no, mark as internal infra term only.

emily: Agree. Add a glossary entry: "replica: internal runtime copy for scaling/availability" and mark redirects from any public pages that accidentally used it.

noelle: Good. Plan: PRs -> #610 (curl fixes), #611 (JS snippet fixes), #612 (style-guide appendix + glossary). Aim to merge by EOD Wednesday for Thursday canary. If you take a PR, drop a short note here so we don't overlap.

cli-bot: preview: branch 611 deployed to preview.docs.redwood/branches/611 (checks passed)

emily: Took #611. I'll run a quick grep for `model_id` in src/content/examples and open per-file tiny commits.

matt: Pushed #610 with the curl JSON conversions and alias example. Left comments in migrate/ for old embed links pointing to /migrate/embeddings-batch.

rahul: Drafted #612 and left the casing table plus one-paragraph rationale for users. Also added the line: "Use 'model variant' in user-facing guides; avoid 'replica' in public-facing content."

noelle: Thanks. After merges we'll run the snippet-runner smoke tests (rahul, can you coordinate with QA?). Also add a short note in the migration guide about alias mapping and model_id usage.

rahul: On it. I'll coordinate the snippet-runner and attach a short report in the PRs.

noelle: One more small UX copy thing: for the console label use 'Variant' (singular) not 'Variants' unless it's a list view. Keep labels concise.

emily: Noted. Will ensure example UI labels follow that.

matt: CI green on #610. Requesting review from emily and noelle.

cli-bot: ci: build passed for branch 610 (https://ci.internal/build/9012)

emily: Reviewing #610 now. Will also scan for any lingering `flavor` occurrences (don't want informal terms leaking into examples).

noelle: If you see 'flavor' or 'magic', replace with 'configuration' or 'variant' and leave a short rationale in the PR description.

rahul: Quick note for the glossary entry: include example sentences for both terms. e.g., "Select a model variant in the Console" and "The runtime scales replicas to meet load."

noelle: Great. Let's try to merge everything by Wednesday EOD. Ping here when PRs are ready for final review. Thanks all! :sparkles:
